summary: folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 728KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and uses that freshly downloaded interpreter to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` (~728 KB, single-line obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle with a rotated string-array dispatcher and hex-mangled identifiers) on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The payload file and setup script are shipped at the tarball root but are not listed in `package.json`'s `"files": ["lib"]` whitelist, so they are delivered outside the declared publish manifest. Using an alternate runtime fetched at install time to execute an opaque obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based inspection and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the declared purpose of the package (folder linting) provides no legitimate reason for this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
